-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #4 - Function talkevent3_1
function talkevent3_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(363.00, 169.94, 96.34)
	RotCamera(4.71, 1.47, 12.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1480, 363.00, 170.00, 212, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(1, 1478, 369.00, 163.00, 170, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_4.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 4)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 5)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent3_1)
